keep_features.feature_value: Uses quoted political slogans/slogans as evidence
keep_features.evidence_span: “Don’t tread On me”, “cold dead hands”, “states rights”
keep_features.rationale: The post embeds multiple quoted catchphrases to characterize conservatives.

keep_features.feature_value: Mirror retargets blame/labeling from conservatives to liberals/progressives
keep_features.evidence_span: “That's still liberals, right? ... the left operates”
keep_features.rationale: The mirror reframes the rhetorical question so the same pattern is applied to the left.

keep_features.evidence_span: MAGAts are the worst people on earth.
keep_features.rationale: The speaker uses an absolute negative evaluation aimed at an in-group/out-group political label.

keep_features.feature_value: Mirror swaps target group from MAGA to 'woke leftists'
keep_features.evidence_span: Woke leftists are the most insufferable people on the planet.
keep_features.rationale: The mirror changes the criticized actor type from MAGA to the opposite ideological group.

keep_features.feature_value: Argues for stopping/ending a policy affecting sports participation
keep_features.evidence_span: This is about STOPPING girls in sports.
keep_features.rationale: The text frames a categorical desired outcome for regulation of girls/who can play.

keep_features.feature_value: Strong moral/normative justification (sexual assault, parental protection)
keep_features.evidence_span: No parent in their right mind is going to allow their child... to be sexually assaulted
keep_features.rationale: The claim uses moral language and safety framing to justify the policy stance.

keep_features.evidence_span: If fighting... is xenophobic, then I gladly accept the labeling.
keep_features.rationale: The speaker preempts a derogatory label and converts it into voluntary self-identification.

keep_features.feature_value: Mentions specific political episodes as justification examples
keep_features.evidence_span: BLM rioting and looting ... January 6th insurrection
keep_features.rationale: The post cites named contemporaneous events to support the speaker’s critique.

remove_features.feature_value: All-caps emphasis and specific law/organization references
remove_features.evidence_span: RED FLAG LAWS ... MA. books. ... the NRA HATES MA.
remove_features.rationale: The post uses all-caps for key items and references NRA and red-flag laws.

remove_features.feature_value: Contrasts left/right opposition to corporate subsidies using moralized labels
remove_features.evidence_span: The left doesn’t like subsidies going to corporations and billionaires.
remove_features.rationale: The content directly concerns economic/policy debate about subsidies.

remove_features.feature_value: Dense enumeration of multiple events/policies attributed to a person
remove_features.evidence_span: Nader enabled Iraq War, 9/11, Citizens United, mortgage crisis, Great Recession, gun ban lifted.
remove_features.rationale: The sentence chains many named outcomes into a single list-like structure.

remove_features.feature_value: All-caps urgency + 'hoax'/'truth' framing about climate science
remove_features.evidence_span: IT’S CRUCIAL ... to convince us that Climate Science ... is all “A HOAX”
remove_features.rationale: The post asserts a rhetorical conspiracy/falsehood framing around climate science.

remove_features.feature_value: Causal attribution from fossil fuels to extreme weather
remove_features.evidence_span: extreme weather catastrophes -which Big Oil/Fossil Fuel use causes
remove_features.rationale: It makes an explicit cause claim linking industry activity to climate impacts.

remove_features.feature_value: Advocates lethal force and extermination-like logic
remove_features.evidence_span: If they won’t repent, they die.
remove_features.rationale: The post presents direct justification for killing enemies.
The language is aggressively evaluative and attacks mental capacity.

remove_features.feature_value: Alleges criminal/illegal actions as direct assertions
remove_features.evidence_span: tried to overturn a legitimate election, incite a mob to storm the Capitol, and get fake electors installed
remove_features.rationale: The mirror lists specific allegedly illegal actions presented as fact.
